title: Understanding Proper Drainage Pipe Pitch
description: Proper pipe slope is critical for a self-clearing drainage system. If a horizontal drain pipe has insufficient slope or a sag, solids settle out of the liquid flow, causing recurring blockages. Conversely, excessive pitch can allow liquids to flow too fast, leaving heavy solids behind. Maintaining correct slope according to local plumbing codes ensures liquids move at an adequate velocity to carry solid waste along the entire pipe run. Regular inspections of pipe hangers prevent sags in long horizontal runs over time.

Understanding Proper Drainage Pipe Pitch

Proper pipe slope is critical for a self-clearing drainage system. If a horizontal drain pipe has insufficient slope or a sag, solids settle out of the liquid flow, causing recurring blockages. Conversely, excessive pitch can allow liquids to flow too fast, leaving heavy solids behind. Maintaining correct slope according to local plumbing codes ensures liquids move at an adequate velocity to carry solid waste along the entire pipe run. Regular inspections of pipe hangers prevent sags in long horizontal runs over time.
